summary: Aurora is an interactive educational game that allows players to design, manage, and simulate space missions. Players build spacecraft, select scientific instruments, plan journeys, and manage limited resources. Combining space exploration, adventure, and engineering challenges, Aurora supports both single-player and cooperative gameplay for up to four players.
